subject: Explainable route cost quick-scan + triage playbook request
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Observability Team <observability@redwood.com>, Tess Walker <tess@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Explainable route cost quick-scan + triage playbook request

Team —

Following a call with Tess (Acme), they've had a few slow routes that also spiked cost unexpectedly. They asked for two things and I'd like us to scope what we can ship in the next sprint:

1) A lightweight "Quick-Scan" button on a route's console page that produces an explainable cost + latency breakdown (top contributing tokens, model variant, batching delta, cache hit rate). Output should be human-readable and link to the raw traces.

2) A triage playbook visible from the same UI: owner tag, common remediation steps (e.g., reduce max_tokens, enable prefix cache for chatflows, fall back to cheaper compatible variant), and a way to open a pre-filled incident with required fields populated.

Why this matters: Acme is evaluating Dedicated and wants actionable visibility without digging through traces. We lose a lot of momentum when a customer sees a spike and the console only shows opaque percentiles.

I've attached a tiny sample export from their tenant (slow_routes_sample.csv) and a sketch for the widget (proposed_widget_mock.png).

Ask: can Product/Obs triage feasibility and provide:
- a short list of required telemetry (metrics/logs/traces) we need to produce the Quick-Scan (deadline: EOD Wed)
- a minimal UX spec (one-pager) and owner for the playbook
- estimate (T-shirt) for engineering to build a first iteration (no more than 2 sprints ideally)

Cc'ing Tess for visibility. Marissa / Marcus / Jonas / Grace — your thoughts?

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Customer Reliability / Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: slow_routes_sample.csv (text/csv), proposed_widget_mock.png (image/png)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Observability Team <observability@redwood.com>, Tess Walker <tess@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Explainable route cost quick-scan + triage playbook request

+1 from Product — this aligns with recent requests. A couple quick notes:

- Telemetry: we will need per-request model_variant, token_count, batch_size, cache_hit boolean, and sampling of the first 3 tokens for attribution. If traces include kv-cache usage counters that helps.
- UX: minimal first pass should be a collapsible right-hand panel with: 1) cost delta attribution (model, tokens, batching), 2) latency waterfall, 3) buttons: "Open incident template" and "Run quick-scan". The PDF mock Naomi attached is helpful.
- Owner: propose Marcus as lead for the Scan backend (metrics/traces mapping) and Jonas to own the console integration/UX. Grace can draft the playbook text and common remediation steps.

Marcus / Jonas / Grace — can you confirm ownership and rough sizing by EOD Wed? If this is >2 sprints we should scope an MVP: Quick-Scan that only surfaces model + token attribution and a playbook link.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Console
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Observability Team <observability@redwood.com>, Tess Walker <tess@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Explainable route cost quick-scan + triage playbook request

Thanks — quick update from the Observability side after a light spike analysis against the sample:

- Feasibility: we can produce a stable Quick-Scan MVP that attributes cost to three buckets: model_compute, token_volume, batching inefficiency. That will require a small new metric: request_estimated_compute_cost (derived at ingestion), plus a 1% sampled trace to capture batch_size and cache_hit. No infra changes beyond a lightweight ingestion transform.
- Sizing (MVP): Backend + metric derivation ~ 5 PD days. Console integration + UI ~ 4 PD days. Playbook content and incident template ~ 2 PD days (Grace to lead). Total ~ 11 PD days (fits into 2 sprints if we split across teams).
- UX ask: allow owner-tagging on the route meta (string) and a "quick-assign" button to set an oncall rotation entry.
- Security/compliance note: sampling traces will need a privacy review for PII — for Acme we can avoid raw prompt text and only capture token hashes for attribution.

Action items:
- Marcus: spin up a small PRD/telemetry checklist and post to OBS-1427 (JIRA).
- Grace: draft playbook and incident template — drop first version into the Drive link by Wed EOD.
- Marissa: confirm the UX mock placement (right panel vs modal) — I lean right panel for lower friction.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Engineering, Observability
Redwood Inference
